profileText: A Delegate from Maryland; born in Prince Georges County, Md., February 12, 1755; served in the Revolutionary War; appointed by General Washington major of Grayson's additional Continental regiment January 1, 1777, and served until December 20, 1777, when he resigned; upon the death of his father devoted his time to the management of the family estate; studied law; was admitted to the bar in 1783, and commenced the practice of law in Frederick County, Md.; Delegate to the Confederation Congress, 1787-1789; died in Frederick County, Md., in 1800.
